title: Felix and the Thorn
author: Felix Yarrow
blurb: Xanthe Reyes, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
